hero.subtitle: RoktoSetu connects patients with verified blood donors nearby, on a live map, in minutes.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Add your NID or passport. Admins review it privately.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Donors who are free right now appear near the patient.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Earn Bronze to Legend badges and rewards.

wizard.title: Donor & User Registration
wizard.subtitle: Complete your profile and identity verification to join the emergency network.

personal.name: Full legal name
personal.weightWarning: Donors must weigh at least 50 kg to be eligible for whole blood donation.

identity.frontDrop: Upload Front side of ID (JPG, PNG, PDF <= 8MB)
identity.selfieDesc: Take a clear live selfie centered in the oval. Our secure verifier checks this against your ID.

health.chronic: Do you have any chronic medical conditions (e.g. cardiac, diabetes, hepatitis)?
health.meds: Are you currently taking any prescription medications?
health.surgery: Have you undergone major surgery in the past 6 months?
health.lastDonation: Date of your last whole blood donation (if any)
health.gapNotice: A mandatory recovery gap of 90 days for men and 120 days for women is enforced between donations.

consent.terms: I agree to the RoktoSetu Terms of Service and acknowledge that blood is never sold or paid for.
consent.privacy: I consent to the processing and Cloud KMS encryption of my identification data for verification purposes.
consent.location: I allow RoktoSetu to use my approximate (~500m fuzzed) location to match emergency blood requests.

common.approxLocation: Locations are approximate. Exact contact is shared after a donor accepts.
